Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer on a paid plan. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you never have to rebuild a list from scratch. Set up the perfect view once—by status, assignee, priority, or due date—and return to it instantly whenever you need it.

Each user can save up to 50 views across their projects, giving you plenty of room to organize work by client, sprint, or personal workflow. Views aren't just for you: any saved view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup and stays aligned on what matters most, without repeating configuration steps or explaining filters over chat.

This feature is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, and it's live now for every eligible workspace. We built Saved Views based on direct customer feedback, and we think it will make your daily planning faster and more consistent.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
